subject: Console token economics snapshot + per-route spend map
messages:
From: Nadia Singh <nadia@brightedge.ai>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com; priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: Luc Tran <luc@brightedge.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: per-route token spend heatmap / snapshot for Q2 planning

Hi Markus and team,

Quick ask from our finance + product partners at BrightEdge: as we prepare our Q2 forecast we need a compact snapshot that shows token spend broken down by Redwood routes (chat/generate/embeddings/rerank) for the last 30 days, plus an easy heatmap that highlights where tail latency is driving the largest cost-per-token.

What would help:
- A CSV with route, total_tokens, avg_cost_per_1k_tokens, p95_latency_ms, median_latency_ms for the last 30 days
- A visual (PNG/PDF) heatmap that maps route x customer-tenant slice to spend buckets (low/med/high)
- Short notes on any known sampling biases (routes that use prefix caching or specialized quantized models)

We know this is a little ad-hoc — if you can send a snapshot by EOD next Wednesday (Apr 28) that would unblock our internal renewal conversation.

Appreciate it — I can share more context if helpful.

Thanks,
Nadia Singh
Head of FinOps, BrightEdge Analytics
Nadia.Singh@brightedge.ai

[attachment: forecast-template.xlsx]

From: markus_klein@redwood.com
To: Nadia Singh <nadia@brightedge.ai>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: per-route token spend heatmap / snapshot for Q2 planning

Nadia — thanks for the clear ask. We're happy to put together the snapshot. Looping in Priyom (Platform Insights) to confirm the export format and any caveats around sampling.

Quick expectations from our side:
- We can produce the CSV + heatmap visualization by 2027-04-28 EOD, unless there are special segmentation rules you need.
- We'll flag routes that are using dedicated cache or are behind a canary model variant (these skew per-token numbers).
- If you need per-tenant drilldowns beyond the top 20 tenants, that's a separate scoped request.

Priyom — can you confirm we have the 30-day token aggregates and p95 latency per route, and advise if the sample includes prefix/KV cache hits (we should mark those)?

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

[attachment: none]

From: priyom_das@redwood.com
To: markus_klein@redwood.com; Nadia Singh <nadia@brightedge.ai>
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 24 Apr 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: per-route token spend heatmap / snapshot for Q2 planning

Markus / Nadia — confirmed, we have the aggregates in Insights (rollup tables updated hourly). A few notes and a proposed minimal deliverable so expectations are aligned: 

Minimal deliverable (by 2027-04-28):
- CSV: route, route_id, total_tokens_30d, est_cost_usd_30d, avg_cost_per_1k_tokens_usd, p50_latency_ms, p95_latency_ms, kv_cache_hit_rate
- Heatmap (PNG): routes on Y axis, tenant buckets on X axis (top 10 tenants by spend + "others"). Color scale: spend per 30d.
- Short caveats file (text): where quantized model variants are used, and examples of routes that get prefix caching.

Caveats:
- est_cost_usd_30d uses current kernel selection + batching profile — if you change quantization or batch size it can swing by ~8-15%.
- Some long-tail routes (low volume) rely on on-demand fallbacks; we will mark these as low confidence.

I've started a small extraction job and attached a sample CSV that follows the schema. Also added a Figma wireframe link for the heatmap so you can confirm layout: https://figma.com/file/ExampleWireframe

If BrightEdge wants an interactive per-route explorer, that's a product roadmap ask (Grace, tagging you). Otherwise this static snapshot should serve the renewal discussion.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Platform Insights, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com

[attachment: sample-snapshot.csv]

From: markus_klein@redwood.com
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.com; priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: Nadia Singh <nadia@brightedge.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: per-route token spend heatmap / snapshot for Q2 planning

Grace — BrightEdge is expecting the snapshot today. Priyom has the export in flight. Two asks from me for product/roadmap:

1) Short-term ask (exception): can Product greenlight a one-off dashboard tile in Console for our Sales team that surfaces the 30-day token economics snapshot (CSV + heatmap PNG) as an ad-hoc report we can run per account? This is not a full explorer — just a generated artifact we can run from the tenant page. We need this for a few strategic deals (BrightEdge + two others) this quarter.

2) Mid-term ask: add a "token economics" card to the tenant overview (p95 latency, est cost, cost per 1k tokens, cache hit rate) as a roadmap candidate. This should be scoped small: initial rollout for Hosted customers only.

If Product approves the exception, I'll file an internal roadmap note and tag INSIGHT-1243 so Eng can prioritize a short implementation (CSV export + PNG generation + S3 link). If not, we'll deliver the static snapshot off-band as planned.

Nadia — we'll send the CSV + PNG by EOD. If you need per-tenant drilldowns beyond the top 10, call that out and we'll scope separately.

Markus Klein
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com
